name: enum-extension-index
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): w is ENUMERATED { a, b, c, ... } with an extension value at index 1 (the second addition, e in the checking module): bit 1, then the index as a normally small non-negative whole number, 0 000001. Decode gives n + index = 3 + 1 = 4 (Transforms on UPER locators); encode of 4 writes the extension form again. 132 bits, padded with 4 zero bits to 17 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
